# Xolvyn
> Architecture-aware code security auditing. Xolvyn scans any GitHub or GitLab
> repository for 50+ vulnerability classes and CVEs, maps the dependency graph,
> and ranks every finding by blast radius — how many files depend on the affected
> code — so teams fix what is load-bearing first. Private beta; launching 2026.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://getxolvyn.com): Product overview, features, pricing, FAQ.
- [Blog](https://getxolvyn.com/blog): Code security, dependency graphs, engineering onboarding.
- [Onboard New Engineers in 3 Days](https://getxolvyn.com/articles/onboard-engineers-codebase-3-days)
- [Careers](https://getxolvyn.com/careers): Open roles — full-stack and AI/ML developer internships.

## Key facts
- Ranks vulnerabilities by blast radius (severity x number of dependent files), not CVSS alone.
- AST-based dependency mapping for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Java.
- 50+ security checks + CVE scanning; OWASP/CWE-aligned; letter grade (A-D) and 0-100 score.
- Auto-Fix Engine opens remediation pull requests on GitHub/GitLab; human review required.
- Privacy: shallow clone, in-memory analysis, immediate deletion; never trains on user code.
- Contact: hello@xolvyn.dev
